channel.description: Recent content in Azure Backup on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Cross-subscription backup for Azure Virtual Machines in Azure Backup
item.description:
Azure Backup now supports cross-subscription backup for Azure Virtual Machines. You can protect VMs with a Recovery Services vault in a different Azure subscription, as long as it is in the same tenant.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Immutable snapshots for Azure Disk Storage
item.description:
Immutable snapshots for Azure Disk Storage are now in public preview. They complement Azure Backup immutable vaults by providing a short-term backup option with faster recovery characteristics.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Backup for Azure Cosmos DB
item.description:
Azure Backup for Azure Cosmos DB is now generally available. It adds vaulted backups with immutable copies stored in an Azure Backup vault, separate from the source Cosmos DB account and managed through Azure Backup.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Cross Tenant Restore with Azure Backup
item.description:
Azure Backup now supports Cross-Tenant Restore in public preview, allowing Azure VM backups to be restored into a separate Azure tenant. This provides an independent recovery path using the existing backup copy, without needing custom backup infrastructure.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Item Level Recovery for Azure VMs with Premium SSDv2 and Ultra Disks in Azure Backup
item.description:
Azure Backup now supports item-level recovery for Azure VMs using Premium SSD v2 and Ultra disks, including both 512-byte and 4KB logical sector sizes. This lets you recover individual files and folders from these VMs.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Backup for PostgreSQL flexible server and elastic cluster (v2)
item.description:
Azure Backup for PostgreSQL flexible server and elastic cluster (v2) is now in preview. It uses physical backups from managed disk snapshots and stores them in an Azure Backup vault for long-term retention.

  • Source: Azure Updates
